title: Mol-Instructions: A Large-Scale Biomolecular Instruction Dataset for Large Language Models
authors_zh: Yin Fang, Xiaozhuan Liang, Ningyu Zhang, Kangwei Liu, Rui Huang, Zhuo Chen, Xiaohui Fan, Huajun Chen
paper_type_zh: 开放指令数据集与构造方法研究
best_for_zh: 训练一个模型处理分子、蛋白质和生物医学文本指令
one_line: Mol-Instructions unifies more than two million molecule, protein, and biomedical-text targets under one instruction schema.
Mol-Instructions 用统一指令结构组织超过 200 万条分子、蛋白质和生物医学文本目标。
why: a shared instruction interface across symbolic biomolecular objects and natural language
inclusion_reason: Mol-Instructions is a public Track 01 training object: task instruction, molecular/protein representation or text input, and structured or natural-language target; it is consumed by domain SFT and cross-task transfer.

title: Problem
问题
html:
General instruction corpora do not connect molecular strings, protein sequences, biomedical text, and task-specific outputs in one reusable training format.

The paper's decision boundary is the released Mol-Instructions training object, not a model-only report or an evaluation-only benchmark. One record contains task instruction, molecular/protein representation or text input, and structured or natural-language target; its selection boundary is chemical/biological labels, exact structured targets, and task-specific metrics, and the records are consumed by domain SFT and cross-task transfer.

L4 facts: the official ICLR 2024 page, public records at https://huggingface.co/datasets/zjunlp/Mol-Instructions, release scale and terms were checked on 2026-07-27. The paper is included because its central contribution directly constructs or curates serialized post-training targets.

通用指令语料没有把分子字符串、蛋白质序列、生物医学文本和任务输出连接为统一可复用格式。

该数据集把 17 类生物分子任务映射到指令、输入与输出三元组，覆盖分子设计、性质预测、蛋白理解和文本任务。 该方法直接产出 Mol-Instructions。本卡的决策边界是可下载训练记录，而不是只有模型的报告或只用于评测的基准；单条记录包含 任务指令、分子或蛋白表示或文本输入，以及结构化或自然语言目标。

L4 事实：已于 2026-07-27 核验 ICLR 2024 官方页面、https://huggingface.co/datasets/zjunlp/Mol-Instructions 的实际公开记录、规模和条款。收录理由是论文中心贡献直接构造或筛选可序列化的后训练目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Mol-Instructions maps 17 biomolecular task families into a common instruction-input-output schema and publishes more than two million examples spanning molecule design, property prediction, protein understanding, and text tasks. The closest comparison is single-task molecular models and generic biomedical chat data; unlike that neighbor, the primary object here is Mol-Instructions and the feedback boundary is chemical/biological labels, exact structured targets, and task-specific metrics, which makes this an instruction/demonstration data paper rather than a model-architecture-only entry.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: public molecule and protein databases organized into 17 task families. Operation: Normalize source identifiers, media or task inputs, and target fields into the release schema. Output and transition: Candidate records containing task instruction, molecular/protein representation or text input, and structured or natural-language target advance to target construction. Check / stop rule: Reject missing inputs, targets, or source provenance.

Step 2 - Write or transform the target. Input: The normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: source database labels, templates, and language-model-written explanatory instructions produces or supplies the target while preserving fields needed for audit. Output and transition: A serialized instruction, demonstration, caption, rationale, or response advances to verification. Check / stop rule: A target that cannot be tied back to its input or source annotation is not retained.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated or transformed candidates. Operation: Apply chemical/biological labels, exact structured targets, and task-specific metrics; deduplicate and assign release splits where documented. Output and transition: Passing records form more than 2 million biomolecular instruction records stored as JSON task files for molecules, proteins, and biomolecular text and advance to training use. Check / stop rule: Keep only records that pass the stated correctness, grounding, format, or selection contract.

Step 4 - Consume the data. Input: The released records and the paper's chosen base model. Operation: Use them for domain SFT and cross-task transfer and compare against single-task molecular models and generic biomedical chat data. Output and transition: A trained checkpoint and controlled evidence about the data intervention become the final evaluated artifacts. Check / stop rule: Judge both target-task quality and regression on general capabilities; no universal early-stopping threshold is disclosed.

Reproducibility requires pinning source revisions, the public manifest, transformation prompts, teacher version, filters, split, base checkpoint, and evaluation harness. The complete generation budget is not disclosed.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：论文核验过的公开任务、媒体、文档或已有指令来源。 操作：统一来源编号、输入和目标字段，并保留追踪信息。 输出及流转：候选记录进入目标构造阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少输入、目标或来源信息的记录直接删除。

步骤 2——撰写或转换目标。 输入：规范化候选及其来源证据。 操作：该数据集把 17 类生物分子任务映射到指令、输入与输出三元组，覆盖分子设计、性质预测、蛋白理解和文本任务。 输出及流转：得到包含 任务指令、分子或蛋白表示或文本输入，以及结构化或自然语言目标 的结构化记录，并进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：不能回溯到输入、来源标注或生成轮次的目标不保留。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成或转换后的候选记录。 操作：按论文披露的正确性、执行结果、视觉落地、格式或质量信号筛选，并在有说明时去重和划分数据。 输出及流转：通过检查的 超过 200 万条生物分子指令记录，覆盖 17 类任务 以 按分子、蛋白质和生物医学文本任务划分的 JSON 文件 发布，随后进入训练。 检查与停止规则：只有满足论文接受契约且必需字段完整的记录进入发布集。

步骤 4——消费数据。 输入：公开记录与论文采用的基础模型。 操作：按论文配方完成指令微调、蒸馏或相应后训练，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的检查点和数据干预的受控证据成为最终评估产物。 检查与停止规则：同时检查目标任务质量和通用能力回退；论文未披露统一早停阈值时不得自行补写。

复现时需固定来源修订版、公开清单、转换提示、教师版本、过滤器、切分、基础检查点和评测工具。完整端到端生成预算若未披露，应保留为未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Instruction-tuned models improve across held-in and cross-domain molecular/protein tasks relative to base and single-task baselines; the same model consumes the common two-million-record mixture.

Impact cross-check: OpenAlex reported 39 citations on 2026-07-27, and the official dataset exposes actual reusable records rather than only weights or examples. The count is an impact signal, not a Google Scholar citation line and not evidence that every record is correct.

在共同指令微调设置下，模型相对基础模型和单任务基线在多个分子与蛋白任务上提高，并显示一定跨任务迁移。结论支持统一任务接口，但不能把生成解释当作实验室证据。

影响力交叉检查：OpenAlex 在 2026-07-27 报告 39 次引用，官方数据集也公开了可复用实际记录，而不是只有权重或样例。该数字只作为影响信号，不是 Google Scholar 引用数，也不能证明每条记录都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work baseline: single-task molecular models and generic biomedical chat data. The actual change is a shared instruction interface across symbolic biomolecular objects and natural language. This is a direction signal because it changes the serialized data object and its selection contract, not merely the backbone. The inherited model family, source tasks, autoregressive loss, and common benchmarks are not new. Before reuse, inspect sequence similarity leakage can inflate apparent cross-task generalization.
相对最近的共同做法，用同一指令结构连接符号化分子对象、蛋白质序列和自然语言任务。 这改变了可审计的数据对象或选择决策，而不只是更换骨干模型。继承的模型家族、自回归训练目标和常用评测并不新；复用前还要检查 序列相似度泄漏会夸大跨任务泛化。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Database labels and molecule splits can leak near-duplicates
  2. generated explanations are not laboratory evidence
  3. source licenses and safety constraints differ by task.

1. 分子或蛋白近重复可能跨切分泄漏，应按结构相似度重查。
  2. 生成解释不等于真实实验机制证据。
  3. 不同数据库的许可和安全边界并不统一。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For training one model to answer molecule, protein, and biomedical text instructions, use the official manifest and schema to build a controlled SFT mixture. The output should be a versioned dataset and a fixed-backbone comparison; success requires the paper's task metrics plus an audit of sequence similarity leakage can inflate apparent cross-task generalization.
  • For data auditing, sample records across sources and reproduce the stated selection contract: chemical/biological labels, exact structured targets, and task-specific metrics. Do not reuse the release when its licensing or source provenance cannot be preserved.

• 若要训练一个模型处理分子、蛋白质和生物医学文本指令，可复用官方清单、记录结构和论文披露的筛选配方。输出应是带版本的数据集与固定骨干对照；成功标准除论文指标外，还要审计 序列相似度泄漏会夸大跨任务泛化。
  • 数据审计者应跨来源抽样，复查必需字段、接受规则和许可。若无法保留来源信息或执行相同检查，就不应直接复用。
